data-model-for-open-datum-signing.text: The data this ticket touches: the shared signer, which command takes which signer, the receipt fields under expected, and the narration events.

signer.text: The signer comes from issue 641, unchanged: key file, external signer or vault. Open-datum adds nothing to it.

which-command-takes-which-signer.text: The table shows, per command, when it takes the key file, the external signer and the vault.

receipt-fields-under-expected.text: Open-datum fields derived from a staged body sit under expected until the whole bundle is found on chain.

narration-events.text: The booked, updated and root seen events never call a staged transaction done.
